description: Cloudflare DNS configuration for PenuX LDAP deployment

registrar_info.nameserver_update_url: Check your registrar's domain management panel

cloudflare_nameservers.note: Replace YOUR_ID with the nameservers provided by Cloudflare when you add the domain

dns_records.notes: Main domain root record. Replace with your public IP (e.g., 203.0.113.42)

dns_records.name: www
dns_records.notes: WWW subdomain. Should point to same IP as root

dns_records.name: ldap
dns_records.notes: GitHub Pages LDAP directory. MUST be DNS only (not Proxied)
dns_records.why_dns_only: GitHub Pages requires DNS-only CNAME for custom domains

dns_records.name: api.ldap
dns_records.notes: Vercel API backend. MUST be DNS only (not Proxied)
dns_records.why_dns_only: Vercel requires DNS-only CNAME for custom domains

dns_records.name: api
dns_records.notes: Alternative API endpoint (optional). Allows api.penux.uk to work

optional_dns_records.notes: Only add if you plan to use email. Replace with your mail server
SPF record for email authentication (if using Google Workspace)

encryption_mode.why: Ensures secure connection from Cloudflare to origin

always_use_https.why: Forces all HTTP traffic to HTTPS

minimum_tls_version.why: Good balance between compatibility and security

http_strict_transport_security.notes: Enforces HTTPS usage. Set to 1 year (31536000 seconds)

bot_management.notes: Free plan includes basic bot detection

nameserver_change.notes: Time for registrar to process nameserver change

dns_record_updates.notes: Time for DNS changes in Cloudflare to propagate globally

vercel_domain_activation.notes: Vercel activates custom domain after DNS verification

dns_not_resolving.solution: Wait 15-60 minutes and flush local DNS cache

cname_conflict_error.cause: A record exists for same name as CNAME
cname_conflict_error.solution: Delete conflicting A record, keep CNAME only

github_pages_certificate_pending.solution: Wait up to 24 hours, check GitHub Pages settings

vercel_domain_404.solution: Wait 5 minutes and reload, or redeploy with 'vercel --prod'

too_many_redirects.cause: Both Cloudflare and GitHub have redirects
too_many_redirects.solution: Disable one redirect, usually in GitHub Pages settings

proxy_status_proxied_instead_of_dns_only.solution: Click cloud icon to change from Proxied to DNS only

implementation_checklist: Add CNAME for ldap (set to DNS only)
Add CNAME for api.ldap (set to DNS only)
Verify all DNS records with nslookup/dig
Verify secure connection indicator (🔒) in browser

important: GitHub Pages and Vercel CNAME records MUST be set to DNS only
Do NOT proxy GitHub Pages or Vercel CNAMEs through Cloudflare
Replace YOUR_PUBLIC_IP_ADDRESS with your actual public IP
Replace yourusername with your actual GitHub username
Replace your-api.vercel.app with your actual Vercel domain
tips: Use Auto for TTL - Cloudflare optimizes automatically
Monitor Cloudflare Analytics for traffic insights
Use Cloudflare email forwarding (free) if needed
Enable HTTP to HTTPS redirect for better SEO
Consider Page Rules for advanced caching control
security_recommendations: Set Security Level to High for protection
Review attack analytics in Cloudflare Dashboard
Consider upgrading to Pro plan for WAF
